entries.en: I'd like to switch up my chrome.
Interesting place to put a clinic.
Lie down, ignore the blood. It's just an old stain.
entries.ro: Întinde-te, nu te uita la sânge. E doar o pată veche.

entries.en: How'd you wind up in Dogtown?
How'd you wind up here? Apparently, everyone in Dogtown's got a story to tell.
entries.ro: Cum ai ajuns pe aici? Parcă toți din Dogtown au câte o poveste.

entries.en: Gives the competition a fighting chance.
You wrap skills like mine in a shiny, new office, all the other rippers in town go bust. Biz 101.
entries.ro: Dacă abilități ca ale mele le împachetezi într-un birou nou-nouț, ceilalți riperi din oraș dau faliment. Afaceri 101.

entries.en: I came to Dogtown to rip, not to chat.
entries.ro: Am venit în Dogtown să rip-uiesc, nu să stau la povești.

entries.en: So, you're runnin' from the past?
I'd like to change my appearance.
Here to freshen up my look.
